disagreements:
両日本語セットはNintendo Switch/Vita対応を明記し、主なルート構造と攻略順は一致する。一方、共通部には literal choice の差（例：Set Aの『袴姿の青年を気にする／死神に関して質問する』に対しSet Bの『先程の声を気にする／目の前の人物を疑う』）や、日生・桐島系で好感度調整用の選択肢差がある。route生成では同一イベントの別選択点か単なる別の成功経路かを各章で照合し、片方の文言を他方へコピーしない。主ルート分岐・終幕は両セットで独立確認済み。Switch版は公式ページで対象を固定し、choroはSwitch版追加要素なしと記載。各portraitはSet A個別攻略ページ上でキャラクター名と並んで表示された画像URLを直接開いて照合済み。 日生ルートの共有SAVE位置にも差がある。Set Aは「日生の意見に乗る」の直前に★日生・桐島・十夜 共通SAVEを置く一方、Set Bは「日生の事を考える」の後／「気になる先輩」の前に光・七葵・十夜共通SAVEを置く。保存位置が食い違うため、規約どおり早いSet A位置を採用し、そのsave stepのjpGuide2は第二ガイド未記載プレースホルダーとする。Set Bの遅いSAVE位置は研究差異として保持し、別SAVEとして重複生成しない。

2026-10-13 unresolved exact-target choices: Hinase Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-hinase-kouryaku) uses はい after 後を追いかける, while Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2949.html) uses いいえ. Independent Switch-compatible corroboration (https://maistar.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-6492.html) also uses いいえ, but its preceding choices differ. Save 6 is now before the chase; the exact post-load choice outcome is still unverified. Chiyo Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-kirishima_chiyo-kouryaku) uses いいえ after 千代の名を呼ぶ, while Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2959.html) uses はい. Independent Switch-compatible corroboration (https://maistar.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-6493.html) also uses はい, but the preceding chapter choices and saved states differ. Preserve the source-lane disagreement. Neither choice has a verified shared saved-state outcome, nor a repository-owner-approved exception; keep Hinase/Chiyo accuracy blocked, reviewed:false, pending exact-state evidence or owner approval.

2026-10-13 additional independent Vita-only source: mizukinoko's 2019 full-route walkthroughs (https://plaza.rakuten.co.jp/mizukinoko/diary/201909170000/ and https://plaza.rakuten.co.jp/mizukinoko/diary/201909180000/) directly show Hinase 後を追いかける → いいえ → 日生-結末, supporting Set B's literal at that decision, and Chiyo 千代の名を呼ぶ → いいえ → 千代-結末, supporting Set A's literal. This demonstrates that independently documented successful paths use both answers across different walkthrough states, rather than resolving either exact Switch saved-state discrepancy. Source identifies Vita only; no exact Switch same-state test. Both blockers remain; no owner exception.

2026-10-13 HalfAdder (https://half-a.net/games1/shinigami.html), independently inspected Japanese walkthrough with unspecified platform: Hinase 後を追いかける→いいえ→GOODEND; Chiyo 千代の名を呼ぶ→いいえ→千代GOODEND. Different preceding decisions prevent a same-state Switch equivalence claim. choro's Switch/Vita hub documents flowchart restart parameter adjustment, which may explain differing outcomes but is not proven here. Both accuracy blockers and reviewed:false remain; no owner exception.

2026-10-23 Kirishima final sequence: Set A (https://www.soregashi.work/entry/shinigami-kirishima_chiyo-kouryaku) prints 迷惑ではない → 桐島先輩の名を呼ぶ → いいえ → はい → 更に名前を呼ぶ → 桐島-結末. Set B (https://choro-game.com/blog-entry-2959.html) prints 迷惑ではない → いいえ → はい → 更に名前を呼ぶ → 七葵エンド. The four shared decision events are independently documented and now transcribed in both route source lanes; Set A's additional 桐島先輩の名を呼ぶ is absent from Set B, so its jpGuide2 stays the omission placeholder. The walkthroughs use different preceding chapter decisions; this does not prove the additional prompt appears in the identical Switch state. Keep this source-gate qualification visible for independent accuracy review; do not infer same-state equivalence.
